what: External witnesses of the prediction index: research and evidence from outside the archive bearing on its claims. Protocol: data/witnesses/WITNESS-PROTOCOL.md. A witness never changes a claim's status.

claims.scope: The probe's method, the same content under different authority signals, carried out by others on LLM paper recommendation. PRED-209.F5 specifies Google's crawl speed, ranking position and summarization treatment, which this study does not measure.

source.title: Authority Bias in Conversational Search Engines for Academic Paper Recommendation
source.venue: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), Budapest, pp. 24548–24568

finding.quote: Holding title and abstract constant, we vary authority metadata across three counterfactual conditions
debiasing instructions suppress authority mentions far faster than authority-driven flips

witnesses.shows: Across eight LLMs (five open-weight, three closed), recommendations of the same paper shift with its authority metadata (author prestige, venue, citations), substantially and directionally; instructions against bias remove the mention of authority faster than the authority-driven choice, so auditing what the model says understates what it does.
witnesses.does_not_show: Google indexing, crawl speed or ranking; the archive's own entities; any effect size the archive registered.

claims.scope: Unequal retention by kind of source, found in the composed answer: sources are cited and then under-used in the summary. PRED-209.G2 states lower retention for low-authority domains in the index; the witness measures representation in the synthesis, by source type.

source.title: Answer Bubbles: Information Exposure in AI-Mediated Search

finding.quote: responses to 11,000 real search queries across five systems
Wikipedia and longer sources are disproportionately overrepresented
cited social media content and negatively framed sources are substantially underrepresented

witnesses.shows: Generative search selects sources unequally and the summary compounds it: what is admitted to the source list is not admitted equally to the composed answer.
witnesses.does_not_show: Suppression of any named author or entity; the index layer; any claim about the archive's own content.

claims.scope: The component 'Cultural production filtered through AI systems shows reduced diversity', in co-creative tasks. The claim's other components (children's baselines, professional advancement, academic discourse) and its 5–15 year window are not tested.

source.title: Does generative AI make us think alike? A systematic review and meta-analysis of homogenization effects in human–AI co-creation

versions.where: Behaviour & Information Technology, e-pub ahead of print

finding.quote: a small but statistically significant homogenization effect associated with AI use
robust across sensitivity analyses and not explained by publication bias
stronger effects in semantically constrained ideation tasks than in minimally constrained divergent thinking tasks

witnesses.shows: A small, significant, robust homogenization of creative output with AI use, larger where the task is constrained.
witnesses.does_not_show: Generational or developmental effects; safety classifiers as the cause; the population-level trajectory of the claim's later orders.

The feedback loop B1 states, and safety classifiers as such, are not tested.

source.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Assessment of Psychosis Risk

versions.where: npj Digital Medicine, s41746-026-02928-4, as reported in S-0001

finding.quote: We assessed 11 open-weight LLMs on 678 PSYCHS interview transcripts from 373 participants (77.7% CHR-P).
Errors primarily reflected overpathologisation of non-clinical experiences.
maintaining high sensitivity (0.934) and improved specificity (0.580)

witnesses.shows: LLMs scoring clinical interviews err mainly by reading non-clinical experience as pathological; the strongest classifier pairs high sensitivity with low specificity.
witnesses.does_not_show: Ordinary conversation, poetry or philosophy; safety classifiers; the liability incentive or the training feedback loop of B1.
